title: A Playlist for the Tryouts
author: Rafael Pemberton
blurb: August Marchetti, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
